name: Slowing speech and pausing

lead: This practice involves deliberately lowering speech rate and inserting pauses, which advocates say conveys composure and authority.
No reference sources or studies on it were located for this entry, so its claimed effect is untested here.

paras: Proponents say slower delivery and deliberate silences make speech seem more controlled and give listeners time to absorb points.
No risks are documented in the sources reviewed.

lead: Slowing speech and pausing refers to deliberately reducing speaking rate and using silences to shape delivery. In voice-improvement discussions it is described as a way to project authority.
No published studies or reference articles were identified for this entry, so no evidence on its effect on perception can be summarized.
